top_signals.title: Supreme Court blocks Scottish Power’s £28m tax write-off
top_signals.summary: Scottish Power is bracing for a million-pound tax bill after losing a protracted legal battle with HMRC. The Supreme Court has ruled that the energy giant cannot deduct £28m in regulatory settlement payments from its taxable corporate profits. The legal case stems from a probe by the energy regulator Ofgem into Scottish Power between 2013 [...]
